The '''CS-Mark 10''', also known as the '''Imperial Command Combat Simulator''' was a device that provided historical simulations of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] greatest battles. The device held 12 historical simulations and a "scenario editor" feature that provided the user with the ability to design their own hypothetical scenarios or recreate other historical battles. Of the twelve battles included, the [[Siege of Trasemene]], the [[Assault on Vardoss IV]] and the [[Battle of Galboron]] were three battles advertised by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]].
